parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. Only a single domain name can be queried at a time.

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The feature names. You can query multiple feature configurations in a single request. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For the features supported by accelerated domain names for ApsaraVideo VOD and their names, see [Feature functions for domain name configuration](~~2411639~~).
